text.description_html:
Laurey 39020, Industrial Cabinet Knob in Matte Black

With its industrial vibe, the Matte Black Wired Cabinet Knob would look sweet in any modern kitchen. Pair it with vibraint cabinets for a truly amazing kitchen refresh. The Industrial Cabinet Knob in Matte Black comes with mounting hardware. The lined details add a unique look that is sure to add style to you lightweight doors and drawers.

This cabinet knob is part of the Laurey Wired Collection.

Specifications and Features of the Laurey 39020 Wired Cabinet Knob Iron Black:

  • Material: Zinc
  • Finish: Matte Black
  • Diameter: 1-1/4"
  • Projection: 1"
  • Packaged with 1" long #8-32 screw and 1-1/2" long #8-32 screw.

Available finishes:
Matte Black Satin Nickel

Sold Individually
